questions.question:
**A sentence has been given in Active/Passive Voice. Out of the four given alternatives, select the one which best expresses the same sentence in** **Passive/Active Voice.** 

My sister will write an application.

options.text: An application would be wrote by my sister.
An application will be wrote by my sister.
An application will be written by my sister.
An application would written by my sister.

questions.solution:
The correct answer is **An application will be written by my sister.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **given sentence is in active voice **and is an **assertive statement.**
 
• While converting from active to Passive, the sentence undergoes the following changes:__
 
• **Rules of Conversion from Active to Passive Voice:**
 
• Identify the subject, the verb and the object: S+V+O
 
• Change the object into subject
 
• The active verb does not have an object. Therefore, the passive form should begin with **you.**
 
• Change the verb into past participle of the verb
 
• Change the subject into object

The sentence in active voice is in the **future tense** (*will write)*. Thus, the active voice will be of the form: *will be + past participle of write i.e **written***.

Hence, the correct answer is: '__*An application will be written by my sister'.*__
